interpretation: Target t0 is post-click and after power-shell; it is not a pre-click baseline or an exact zero-latency frame. capture captured_at is after file retrieval; use remote_stat and command receipts for timing.

media-selected.txt uses the complete received stderr and absolute line numbers. Correlate against stderr_baseline_lines; pre-tap lines do not prove post-tap consumption. Full raw and delta are preserved.

Pre-tap parent/child births, PPID, UID and run SHA are checked. Each transport operation checks lock and boot. End child stat/maps reads are nonrequired and retained; this collector does not assert same child at each screenshot or after the tap. Independently validate final stat/raw command rc and binding reader identity.
read_binding must independently complete both exact matches and identity_after_reads. The observation script no longer emits a legacy got.json.
WL-TTLOG skipped-format records are markers, not prepare/dataSource/error message bodies. Zero selected lines cannot prove no player call because filtering/limits/write failure remain possible.
No image, READY, live PID, matched pointer or log line alone proves video playback or audio.
